CalloutConfig.DispatchText: Car accident nearby. Someone has a small cut and needs a bandage.
CalloutConfig.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. Minor car accident nearby. A person has a small cut and needs help. Please respond.
CalloutConfig.EnRouteHelpText: Drive to the yellow marker, then get out and walk up to the patient.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneText: You're on scene. Check on the patient.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneVoiceLine: On scene. Checking on the patient now.

OnSceneTextVariants.string: You made it! Let's go check on them.
Right on scene. Time to see how they're doing.
You're here. Let's take a look at the patient.

CalloutConfig.AssessmentHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to help the patient.

TreatingTextVariants.string: Cleaning the cut and wrapping it up...
Taking good care of that injury...

CalloutConfig.TreatedText: All better! The patient is treated and feeling good.
CalloutConfig.TransportedText: The patient is taken to the hospital for a checkup. Great job!
CalloutConfig.ResolutionVoiceLine: Nice work. The patient is going to be just fine.

Injury.DispatchText: Minor car bump. Someone has a small cut and needs a bandage.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. Minor car bump nearby, a person has a small cut. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: I just got a little cut, it stings a bit.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: No worries, let me pop a bandage on that.

Injury.TreatedText: All better! Just a small cut - cleaned and bandaged.

Injury.DispatchText: Car accident. Someone has hurt their arm and needs help.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. Car accident nearby, a person has hurt their arm. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: Ow, my arm really hurts. I banged it in the crash.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Sit tight, I'll wrap it up and get you comfy.

Injury.TreatedText: Nice work - arm wrapped up and the patient feels much better.

Injury.DispatchText: Serious car accident. Someone is hurt badly and may need the hospital.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. Serious car accident nearby, a person is badly hurt. Please respond quickly.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: I feel really dizzy... my head hurts a lot.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Stay still, you're going to be okay. Let's get you to the hospital.

Injury.TransportedText: Great job! The patient is safely taken to the hospital for care.

PatientThanksTextVariants.string: I feel so much better now, thank you!

CalloutConfig.ConversationHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to talk to the patient.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: Ow... I bumped my arm in the crash. It stings a little.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: It's okay, I'm here to help. Can you move it alright?

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: Yeah, I can move it. It's just a small cut.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Great. Let me clean it up and put a bandage on.
